name: Fragment builds
definition: Elements appear in steps (fade, grow, shrink, highlight or fade out), including bullets revealed one per click.

demo.how: A fragment is one piece of a slide with its own build effect. Play runs five in turn on one slide: a point fades in, a second grows in, the first gets highlighted, a third shrinks into place, and the second fades out. A tag names each effect as it runs.
